projects.title: River
projects.description: A lightweight Redis-inspired key-value database built in Rust to explore systems programming, networking, concurrency, and persistence. It includes a custom TCP protocol, TTL-based expiration, sharded storage, and modular storage and networking layers.

projects.title: StudyGee
projects.description: A Nigerian learning platform for exam practice, study materials, and AI-assisted learning. I built the backend systems powering users, subjects, questions, authentication, and study flows, with the architecture designed to support multiple platforms.

projects.title: Penny Wise
projects.description: A personal finance application for tracking income and expenses, organizing transactions, and visualizing spending patterns. I built the complete application flow, from the data model and REST API to the frontend experience and financial summaries.

projects.title: Share It
projects.description: A peer-to-peer file-sharing application that transfers files directly between browsers using WebRTC. The system uses Socket.IO for signaling while keeping the actual file transfer between connected peers.

projects.title: NexWAD
projects.description: A campus platform for AFIT students combining a marketplace, social network, lost-and-found features, and real-time messaging. The platform brings multiple student services together through a shared backend and real-time communication layer.

projects.title: WaterCast
projects.description: A live-streaming platform built around real-time video, chat, and session management. The backend combines WebRTC and Socket.IO to coordinate low-latency communication while handling users, sessions, and supporting application data.

projects.title: Solana CRUD Smart Contract
projects.description: An on-chain CRUD program built with Rust and Anchor for creating, updating, fetching, and deleting records on Solana. It explores PDA-based account management, ownership validation, event emission, and deterministic on-chain state.

projects.title: School Portal API
projects.description: A school management and CBT backend for students, courses, examinations, results, and timed test sessions. It implements role-based access control, protected sessions, Redis caching, background jobs, and structured API documentation.

projects.title: Chuks Kitchen API
projects.description: A production-style food ordering API covering menus, carts, orders, authentication, and order lifecycle management. It uses OTP authentication, request validation, strict state transitions, and business-rule enforcement across the ordering flow.

projects.title: Predicta - Solana Prediction Market dApp
projects.description: A decentralized prediction market built on Solana for creating markets, trading YES/NO positions, providing liquidity, and claiming rewards. The project explores smart contract architecture, PDA design, token management, market settlement, liquidity, and on-chain state management.

projects.title: Talent Flow - Learning Management System
projects.description: A web-based learning management system for organizing courses, lessons, learning materials, and student progress. The platform provides a structured workflow for delivering educational content and managing the learning experience.

projects.title: FlowPay - Multi-Currency Payment Gateway
projects.description: A multi-currency payment gateway demonstrating end-to-end processing across fiat and cryptocurrency. FlowPay combines Node.js, Rust, PostgreSQL, and Solana Devnet for wallets, payments, currency conversion, betting transactions, blockchain verification, and reliable settlement with a double-entry ledger.

projects.title: Pulse
projects.description: A real-time odds calculation engine demonstrating low-latency event processing, deterministic provably-fair computation, Redis-based live state, PostgreSQL persistence, and WebSocket-based updates. A goal triggered in the dashboard streams recalculated odds and fairness proofs to every connected client.

projects.title: Verity
projects.description: An independent audit service for gaming platforms built around a committed-randomness protocol. Operators register games and run rounds that produce independently verifiable fairness evidence, with every state transition recorded in a tamper-evident hash-chained audit log anchored by signed checkpoints.

projects.title: GhostTrack
projects.description: A web service that brings multiple OSINT lookup capabilities behind a unified API. It integrates lookup tools for IP addresses, phone numbers, and usernames into a single service for streamlined investigation workflows.

projects.title: Water Digital Corp.
projects.description: A responsive business website for a digital services company helping small businesses establish an online presence. The site focuses on clear service presentation, responsive design, and turning visitors into potential clients.

projects.title: Kenri Ideas
projects.description: A portfolio website for a graphic designer built around visual presentation. The layout keeps the designer's work at the center while providing a clean way to showcase services and creative projects.

projects.title: Age Verifier
projects.description: A lightweight JavaScript application that validates profile information and calculates age from a user's date of birth. Built as a focused exercise in client-side validation, date handling, and immediate user feedback.

projects.title: Solve This!
projects.description: A combinatorics calculator for factorials, permutations, and combinations. It provides fast, accurate calculations through a simple interface designed for students and anyone working with basic counting problems.

projects.title: Nigerian Flag Cursor
projects.description: An interactive canvas experiment featuring a custom cursor inspired by the Nigerian flag and coat of arms. It combines canvas rendering with real-time mouse tracking to create a responsive visual effect.
